ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ ابْتَلَيْتَنَا فِي أَرْزَاقِنَا بِسُوءِ الظَّنِّ
en: O God, Thou hast tried us with distrust in our provisions
and the expectation of long lives,

ar: حَتَّى الْتَمَسْنَا أَرْزَاقَكَ مِنْ عِنْدِ الْمَرْزُوقِينَ،
en: until we begged for provisions from those who are provided
and craved in our expectations the life-spans of the long-lived!
So bless Muhammad and his Household,

ar: وَهَبْ لَنَا يَقِيناً صَادِقاً تَكْفِينا بِهِ مِنْ مَؤونَةِ الطَّلَبِ،
en: give us a true certainty that will suffice us the burden of seeking,

ar: وَأَلْهِمْنَا ثِقَةً خَالِصَةً تُعْفِينَا بِهَا مِنْ شِدَّةِ النَّصَبِ،
en: and inspire us with a sincere trust that will release us from the hardship of exertion!

ar: وَاجْعَلْ مَا صَرَّحتَ بِهِ مِنْ عِدَتِكَ فِي وَحْيِكَ،
en: Let Thy clear promise in Thy Revelation
which Thou hast followed in Thy Book with Thy oath

ar: قَاطِعاً لاهْتِمَامِنَا بِالرِّزْقِ الَّـذِيْ تَكَفَّلْتَ بِهِ
en: cut off our worry about the provision for which Thou hast made Thyself responsible

ar: وَحَسْمَاً لِلاشْتِغَالِ بِمَا ضَمِنْتَ الْكِفَايَةَ لَهُ،
en: and sever our occupation with everything whose sufficiency Thou hast guaranteed!
For Thou hast said - and Thy word is the most truthful truth
and Thou hast sworn - and Thy oath is the most kept and fulfilled
"In the heaven are your provision and everything you are promised" (51:22)!

ar: ثُمَّ قُلْتَ: ( فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ إنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ ).
en: And then Thou hast said, "So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as surely true as that you have speech" (51:23)!
